provider.name: Stakeshop Pty Ltd
provider.description: Sydney-founded fintech broker (trading as Stake) offering CHESS-sponsored ASX trading and US share/ETF investing for Australians.

offering.name: Stake
offering.description: Stake's CHESS-sponsored ASX share trading and custodial US (Wall St) share and ETF investing platform for Australians, with a flat low-dollar brokerage fee on both sides.

markets.notes: Stake advertises 11,000+ US stocks, ETFs, government bonds and OTC securities under one "Wall St" product; exact per-exchange coverage (NYSE vs. Nasdaq) not confirmed against an official breakdown.
Stake advertises 11,000+ US stocks, ETFs, government bonds and OTC securities under one "Wall St" product; exact per-exchange coverage (NYSE vs. Nasdaq) not confirmed against an official breakdown.

products.notes: "Wall St" product: US-listed stocks and ETFs only.
Government bonds listed under the Wall St product on the official pricing page; not broken out further.

custody.description: Only whole shares supported on ASX (no fractional ASX shares); ASX minimum marketable parcel rules apply to the initial purchase.
Wall St holdings are held via a custodial structure, not CHESS/HIN; fractional shares are supported from US$10.
Wall St holdings are held via a custodial structure, not CHESS/HIN; fractional shares are supported from US$10.

accountTypes.notes: Available via Stake Super, a separate SMSF administration product/entity (Stake SMSF Pty Ltd) layered on top of a standard Stake trading account; Stake Super's own annual fee (from $990) is not modelled as an OfferingFee here -- see the research manifest.

fees.label: Australian shares brokerage
fees.notes: Effectively a flat A$3 per trade up to A$30,000, then 0.01% of trade value above that. CHESS-sponsored, settled to your own HIN.

fees.label: US shares brokerage (Wall St)
fees.notes: Effectively a flat US$3 per trade up to US$30,000, then 0.01% of trade value above that. Custodial model, not CHESS-sponsored. Fractional shares available from US$10.

fees.label: US shares brokerage (Wall St)
fees.notes: Effectively a flat US$3 per trade up to US$30,000, then 0.01% of trade value above that. Custodial model, not CHESS-sponsored. Fractional shares available from US$10.

fees.label: Foreign exchange conversion (AUD to USD funding)
fees.notes: Charged when converting AUD to USD to fund Wall St trading, not on each individual trade. No separate per-trade FX fee for Wall St orders once funded.
